title: 18-year-old nephew of Nabalawag's vice mayor shot dead in Olandang
summary: Two gunmen on motorcycles shot dead Morsid A. Lakiman, 18, of Sitio Alim, Barangay Kadingilan, as he sat on his motorcycle under a tree in Barangay Olandang, Nabalawag, Special Geographic Area, at about 1:20 p.m. on Thursday, 5 November 2026. He was a nephew of Nabalawag Vice Mayor Peng Akmad "Samurai" Lakiman. The gunmen fled; the motive was not known.

sources.title: 18-Year-Old Nephew of Nabalawag Vice Mayor Killed in Broad Daylight Shooting

title: Rocket-propelled grenade fired at the Nabalawag vice mayor's compound in Kadingilan; residents flee again
summary: Armed men attacked the compound of Nabalawag Vice Mayor Peng "Samurai" Akmad Lakiman in Barangay Kadingilan, Nabalawag, Special Geographic Area, on Saturday, 21 November 2026, reportedly firing a rocket-propelled grenade that struck a house inside it. No one was reported hurt, but residents of Sitio Alim and nearby communities, some back home for only two days after earlier clashes, fled again; Philstar put the displaced from the fighting at 339 families. The conflict between two armed groups there began on 16 September.

sources.title: Renewed Armed Violence in Nabalawag Forces Residents to Flee Again; Military Deploys Additional Forces
Villager wounded, hundreds displaced amid Moro clan conflict

title: Farmer shot dead while tapping rubber trees in Lukketon, Sumisip
summary: Unidentified armed men shot dead a farmer as he tapped rubber trees on his farm in Sitio Sucaten, Barangay Lukketon, Sumisip, Basilan, on Saturday, 21 November 2026, about 14 kilometres from the town's police station. Police did not release his name; the motive and the gunmen were not known.

sources.title: Farmer Shot Dead While Tapping Rubber Trees in Sumisip, Basilan

title: Couple wounded as motorcycle gunmen fire on their minivan in Gadungan, Sultan sa Barongis
summary: Two men on a motorcycle followed and fired on a minivan carrying Rauf Bagundang Guiapar, 26, a farmer, and his wife Baby Ann Ibrahim Alabat, 21, on the boundary of Barangays Gadungan and Kulambog, Sultan sa Barongis, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 3 p.m. on Monday, 23 November 2026, as they drove home from Tacurong. Both were wounded and taken to a hospital in Lambayong; their child, also in the van, was unhurt. The motive and the gunmen were not known.

sources.title: Couple Wounded in Motorcycle-Riding Gunmen’s Ambush in Sultan Sa Barongis

title: Man with four reported arrest warrants shot dead on a road in Baas, Lamitan City
summary: Two unidentified gunmen shot dead Basri Tukul, 21, of Barangay Cabengbeng, Sumisip, as he walked along a barangay road in Barangay Baas, Lamitan City, Basilan, at about 8:50 a.m. on Monday, 23 November 2026. He died at the scene and the gunmen fled toward a forested area. Lamitan police said he reportedly faced four outstanding warrants, for murder and frustrated murder, subject to verification; six spent cartridges, from .45-calibre and 7.62mm firearms, were recovered. The motive was not known.

sources.title: 21-Year-Old Man With Four Reported Arrest Warrants Shot Dead in Lamitan City

title: 2 soldiers seriously wounded as gunmen fire on their motorcycle on the national highway in Sultan Kudarat
summary: Gunmen opened fire on two soldiers riding a motorcycle along the national highway in Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, on the afternoon of Tuesday, 24 November 2026, seriously wounding both. Police arrested two suspects in a hot pursuit operation.

sources.title: 2 soldiers wounded in Maguindanao del Norte ambush
